sentences.ar: عشت تلات سنين وأنا بحسبه ميت.
sentences.en: I lived three years believing him dead.
I still read the newspapers with his eye.

sentences.ar: بيوم، اصطدمت بعجوز بيبيع كتب بالشارع.
sentences.en: One day, I bumped into an old bookseller in the street.
His books fell and I apologised and walked on.
An hour later, the old man came to the surgery.
I turned, and Sherlock Holmes was standing before me.

sentences.ar: وهاي المرة الوحيدة بحياتي اللي أغمى عليّ.
sentences.en: And that is the only time in my life I fainted.
